narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed during the afternoon hours across the Ohio Valley ahead of an upper level low pressure system moving through the region.
ev: Several roads were closed across the northeast part of Franklin County due to flash flooding, including Liberty Pike and Whitcomb Road, Kunkel Road north of Whitcomb Road and Farm Hill Road between Mud Road and Liberty Pike. An old bridge from the early 1900s was washed out.
